definitions.caption: Definition of Terms
rows: A photograph captured from an elevated position using an unmanned aerial vehicle (drone), used as the primary input for disease detection and spatial mapping in this study.
A viral disease of banana plants transmitted by aphids, characterized by stunted growth, narrow upright leaves, and dark green streaks on leaf margins, capable of causing severe yield loss.
A foliar fungal disease caused by Pseudocercospora fijiensis, producing dark leaf streaks and necrotic lesions that reduce photosynthetic capacity and fruit quality.
A tabular evaluation metric that compares predicted disease classifications against actual labels, from which accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score are derived.
An unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with a camera used to capture georeferenced images of banana plantations from a predefined flight altitude and speed.
The harmonic mean of precision and recall, providing a single metric that balances false positives and false negatives in model evaluation.
The process of attaching geographic coordinates (latitude and longitude) to detected disease locations, enabling spatial mapping of infection points on a plantation map.
A spatial visualization that uses color intensity to represent the concentration or severity of detected disease occurrences across a mapped plantation area.
A graphical user interface that displays banana plantation areas with overlaid disease heatmaps and geotagged detection points for farmer decision support.
A computer vision task that identifies and localizes objects of interest, such as disease symptoms, within an image by drawing bounding boxes around detected instances.
A soil-borne fungal disease caused by Fusarium oxysporum f.sp. cubense that blocks vascular tissue, causing leaf yellowing, wilting, and plant death.
The proportion of true positive detections among all positive predictions made by the model, indicating the reliability of disease identifications.
The proportion of actual disease instances correctly detected by the model, indicating the completeness of disease identification.
A single-stage deep learning object detection algorithm selected for real-time identification of Panama disease, Black Sigatoka, and BBTV from aerial banana plantation images.
